rows.grounds: samāveśas-tādātmyaṃ = penetration-identity (nominative singular neuter compound; samāveśa + tādātmya)
nāparaṃ = not-other (nominative singular neuter compound; na + apara)

tenāvikalpā = by-that-non-conceptual (AMBIGUOUS: surface suggests instrumental 'tena' + 'avikalpā', but glossed as compound adjective qualifying saṃvittiḥ; analyzed as nominative singular feminine compound tad + avikalpa)
saṃvittir-bhāvanādy-anapekṣiṇī = awareness-meditation-independent (nominative singular feminine compound; saṃvitti + bhāvanādi + anapekṣin)
